synthetic_notice: This is a synthetic reference orbit defined by literal initial conditions. It is not a real spacecraft, not KMU-ET02, and no result derived from it describes real orbital performance.

state.semi_major_axis_derivation: 6378137.0 m WGS-84 equatorial radius + 700000.0 m altitude, exact
state.degenerate_element_note: For e = 0 the argument of perigee and true anomaly are not individually defined; both are fixed to 0.0 so that each tool receives an identical literal rather than applying its own convention.

central_body.why_explicit: Tool defaults for mu differ in the last significant digits. Left implicit, that difference alone would appear in the delta table as an implementation disagreement.

stations.role: high-latitude coverage, carried over from EVD-ORB-01 so the two fixtures differ only in the orbit

tangent-pass coverage; its best pass culminates at 5.047622 deg, only 0.048 deg above the mask. Selected by an oracle-only scan of twelve candidate sites (evidence/orbit/oracle/gmat/EVD-ORB-02-tangent-scan.script); the product engine took no part in the choice.

station_notice: All five stations are synthetic verification coordinates chosen for geometric coverage. None is a KMU site.
coverage_note: W1 gives many passes at every station and the tangent case. W2 gives both boundary-clipping cases and three zero-contact stations. Unlike EVD-ORB-01, this fixture has no analytically guaranteed zero-contact station, because a 98 deg inclination orbit reaches every latitude; the zero-contact case is therefore established by the short window rather than by geometry.

propagator.resolved_by: PM decision Q-DATA-03, 2026-09-03, recorded in docs/specs/ORBIT_VERIFICATION_CONTRACT.md section 7.2 and its amendment log

analysis_windows.purpose: Primary 24 h window: many passes at every station, including a tangent pass at SYN-GS-TANGENT.

Boundary clipping and zero contact, derived from the oracle's W1 output by the rule in contract section 7.1. At i = 98 deg every station sees passes over 24 h, so a short window is the only way this fixture can exercise the zero-contact case.
